up: Retrieve IC50 activities in nM against target CHEMBL1824 (Receptor tyrosine-protein kinase erbB-2). Return columns: canonical_smiles, compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id if available, otherwise use doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Apply filters: target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', organism = 'Homo sapiens', canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, and at least one of pubmed_id or doi must be non-null. Return only DISTINCT rows for the specified columns.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1824'
  AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
